seed-bell prop vocabulary, bipedal craft action, and outdoor composition only

preflightReferences.derivation: Border-connected neutral near-white matte normalized to exact #FFFFFF; artwork and disconnected highlights preserved.
preflightReferences.acceptance: Fern is upright with the dusty-teal satchel; Pipkin has two gold-tipped antennae and exactly four warm-gold wings; silhouettes and relative scale are clean.

preflightReferences.purpose: Lock orderly, tangled, partially freed, and ready bell/ribbon states.
preflightReferences.derivation: Border-connected neutral near-white matte normalized to exact #FFFFFF.
preflightReferences.acceptance: Native 4:3 two-by-two sheet with exactly four groups and exactly three dusty-blue, berry-pink, and warm-ochre bells per group. Text continuity remains authoritative for which ribbons are open in each state.

preflightReferences.purpose: Lock 4:3 location geometry, high knot, thorn gap, root cottages, and interaction path.
preflightReferences.derivation: Targeted ribbon-topology repair followed by border-connected neutral near-white normalization to exact #FFFFFF.

globalConstraints: Native 4:3 composition with complete action in frame and no responsive crop.
Pure #FFFFFF matte; organic watercolor edges must not reveal a rectangle.
Locally color-matched contours; never one universal brown or black outline.
Semantic environmental richness without paper grain, hatching, stippling, or repeated surface marks.
Fern stays upright with the dusty-teal satchel; Pipkin has exactly four warm-gold wings.
The high knot opens once at u11 and the bells resume once at u13.

candidates.notes: First rendered identity candidate passed anatomy, satchel, palette, and relative-scale review.
The requested independent second candidate returned only text and no distinct rendered asset.
Provider changed the requested native 4:3 sheet to 3:2 and rendered only three state groups.
Alternate 3:2 output also contained only three state groups.
Corrected 4:3 two-by-two layout, but the top-left and bottom-left groups each contained only two bells.
Targeted repair restored one dusty-blue bell to each deficient left quadrant, producing twelve visible bells.
Location, identity, count, and matte were strong, but all three ribbons were incorrectly bundled into one central knot.
Targeted repair freed the berry-pink and warm-ochre ribbons and retained exactly one dusty-blue high knot.

rejections.reason: Wrong 3:2 ratio and incomplete three-state coverage.
Two left quadrants were missing the dusty-blue bell.
All ribbons were bundled together, eliminating the authored one-high-knot interaction.

notes: All three canonical references passed full-frame visual QA on 2026-07-16. Provider originals are preserved; delivery PNGs were derived with the project skill's border-connected matte normalizer. Do not generate story motion until the selected narration master establishes beat durations.
